# Monotonic Safety on Shared State

When multiple steps touch shared resources, keep updates orderly and reviewable.

## Read-decide-write

Load current state, decide once, apply once; avoid interleaved partial writes racing themselves.

## Timing honesty

For durations and deadlines, use a single clock basis across comparisons to prevent drift bugs.

## Explicit comparisons

Make boundary conditions visible in code or scripts instead of implicit edge behavior.
